edits.before: After Chong Hou concluded a treaty with Russia, the court argued it out for months without reaching a decision. Zuo Zongtang's memorial put the objection into items — the border terms and the trade terms, each marked as unacceptable — set out a two-stage plan of negotiation followed by battle, and volunteered to take command at Hami. Faced with a badly negotiated agreement, opposing it is not enough: you have to say which clauses cannot move, and what stands behind your demand to talk again.
edits.after: After Chong Hou concluded a treaty with Russia, the court debated it at length without reaching a decision. Zuo Zongtang's memorial put the objection into items — the border terms and the trade terms, each marked as unacceptable — set out a two-stage plan of negotiation followed by battle, and volunteered to take command at Hami. Faced with a badly negotiated agreement, opposing it is not enough: you have to say which clauses cannot move, and what stands behind your demand to talk again.

edits.before: A treaty negotiated abroad by a plenipotentiary envoy had been sent home to the capital. Officials impeached it one after another, and the debate dragged on toward no conclusion. The trouble was never whether Ili mattered. The trouble was that the treaty had already been signed. Accept it, and the lost territory and compromised rights stood as a fait accompli. Repudiate it, and someone had to go back to the table carrying enough leverage to make the other side sit down again.

edits.before: If what they had spotted was our fear of war, the answer had to put both options on the table at once: "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory" — closing with "Though I am old, tired, and of no great ability, how dare I not do my best." edits.before: After Chong Hou concluded a treaty with Russia, the court debated it at length without reaching a decision. Zuo Zongtang's memorial put the objection into items — the border terms and the trade terms, each marked as unacceptable — set out a two-stage plan of negotiation followed by battle, and volunteered to take command at Hami. Faced with a badly negotiated agreement, opposing it is not enough: you have to say which clauses cannot move, and what stands behind your demand to talk again.

edits.before: The author's reading is that this memorial carried weight through its structure, not merely its stance. It broke the objection into items — one for the border terms, one for trade, each with its own stated reason for refusal. It wrote the plan as a sequence: negotiation first, battle second. And by volunteering to hold Hami, it made the second step concrete — a named man in a named place. That the court then sent Zeng Jize to revise the earlier treaty, and that Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, is on the record.
